MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 P-H3 Image needs ComfyUI 0.44.0 or newer, the first version with these nodes. On an older ComfyUI the nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist. This is the First and Last Frame version of MiniMax H3 (fl2va): if you did Episode 41 you may already have it.

 LoRA (in LoRA Loader Pixaroma)

Download p-h3-image_lora_bf16.safetensors1.82 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/loras/h3

Create the h3 folder inside loras if it does not exist.

 Load CLIP

Download p-h3-image_text_encoder_int8_convrot.safetensors4.77 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download p-h3-image_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors2.93 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 License

P-H3 Image is built on MiniMax H3, so the MiniMax H3 Community License applies. Read it and check what it says for your country before you use the model.

READ LICENSE P-H3 Image model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

This is inpainting: draw a box on your picture and write what happens in it, and the model changes only that area. Apart from a soft edge around the box, everything stays exactly your picture. The demo takes the bicycle away from a bakery front.

 Steps

  1. Load your picture in Load Image Mini Pixaroma.
  2. On Sketch Pixaroma, delete the demo box, pick the box tool and drag a box around what to change, or around an empty spot where something should go.
  3. Write what happens in the box in Prompt Pixaroma.
  4. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  5. Press Run. Drag across Image Compare Pixaroma to see before and after.

 Writing the prompt

  • Write it as an instruction: Remove the bicycle and the black stand beside it.
  • Say what should be there afterwards. The model needs it to know what goes behind: so the dark green shop panel and the white door frame show in full, above the bare pavement.
  • To change something, give the colour, the material and the shape: Replace the wicker armchair with a dark green leather armchair with rounded arms.
  • End with Keep everything else exactly unchanged.

 How it works

  • P-H3 Image has no mask input, so the masking happens around it.
  • The box becomes a mask. Inpaint Crop cuts out the box with some of the picture around it and makes it bigger, the model changes only that piece, and Inpaint Stitch pastes it back with a soft edge.

 Good to know

  • Do not use the prompt output of Sketch Pixaroma here. It says Inside the red box ..., and P-H3 Image then painted a red line into the picture on 4 of 4 seeds, though it never saw a box. The plain prompt took the bicycle out on 4 of 4.
  • Only the area around the box changes. We compared the result with the picture: the change ends about 100 px past the box, where the soft edge ends. Everything farther out is your picture.
  • Replacing works too. In a test the wicker armchair became a green leather one on 4 of 4 seeds, and the plant and the table beside it look the same.
  • Say what goes behind. The model has to invent what the bicycle was hiding. Naming the panel, the door frame and the pavement gave it the right things to draw.
  • target 1024 is twice as fast. On Inpaint Crop Pixaroma it took about 5 s, and the bicycle came out just as clean. Only the new wood looks a little different.
  • The result has the size of your picture. The demo goes in and comes out at 1024 x 1024.
  • Tested with one box per Run.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 fl2va) - MiniMax H3, the video model. The LoRA in the next node turns it into P-H3 Image, a picture model. If you did Episode 41 you may already have this file.
  • LoRA Loader Pixaroma (P-H3 Image) - The P-H3 Image LoRA from Pruna. Keep it on at strength 1: without it H3 is a video model and the picture falls apart.
  • Load CLIP (P-H3 Image text encoder) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the model understands. The type must be minimax.
  • Load VAE (P-H3 Image VAE) - Turns the finished render into the picture. It is made for P-H3 Image, a different file from the H3 video VAE.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture) - The picture to change. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Sketch Pixaroma (2. draw a box) - Draw a box around what to change, or around an empty spot where something should go. Only the box area and a soft edge around it change. Its mask output tells Inpaint Crop where the box is. Leave the note empty: the change goes in Prompt Pixaroma.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (3. what happens in the box) - Say what happens in the box and what should be there afterwards (see How to Use).
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 1.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs between the steps.

  • Inpaint Crop Pixaroma (cuts out the box area) - Cuts out the box with 96 px of the picture around it, so the model sees what surrounds it, and enlarges it to 1536 px on its long side. Leave it as it is. Do not paint in its own mask editor: a mask painted there replaces the box from Sketch.
  • Inpaint Stitch Pixaroma (pastes it back) - Pastes the changed area back into your picture with a wide soft edge (softness 96). Everything farther out is your original picture, pixel for pixel. If a faint patch shows, raise softness, or try a new seed.

 Working in the background

Teal. They run by themselves. The line next to each one says if there is anything worth changing.

  • MiniMaxH3SigmaShift (1 / 1 for pictures) - The noise schedule. P-H3 Image needs 1 and 1. Leave it as it is.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • PH3 Image Conditioning (prompt + the cut-out area) - Joins the prompt and the cut-out area. The model only ever sees this piece of your picture. With width and height on 0, the result has the size and shape of the piece.
  • Basic Guider (no CFG) - Hands the model and the prompt to the sampler. P-H3 Image needs no CFG and no negative prompt.
  • KSampler Select (sampler) - The sampler. euler is the one in Pruna's own workflow. ComfyUI's template uses er_sde: the same speed, but it broke small words on a label in our tests.
  • Manual Sigmas (the 8 steps) - The 8 steps the model was trained on. More steps do not help, so leave these numbers as they are.
  • Random Noise - The starting noise, from the seed.
  • Sampler Custom Advanced (the render) - The render itself: 8 steps. The normal KSampler cannot take this hand-made step list, so this node does the job.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/P-H3 Image Box and shows it on the node.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (before and after, drag across it) - Your picture and the result on top of each other. Drag across it: only the box area and its soft edge change.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: a smaller picture is much faster.

WhatTime
target 1024about 5 s
target 1536 (the demo)about 9 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 20 GB for H3, and 10 GB for the LoRA, the text encoder and the VAE), so it takes longer. After that they stay in memory, if your PC has enough of it. Two testers with 16 GB cards: with 64 GB of RAM the next Runs were close to the times above; with 32 GB the models loaded from disk again on every Run, and each Run took about 4 times as long.

 On a smaller card

Lower target on Inpaint Crop Pixaroma to 1024.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
